name: calendar
title: Calendar
description: Standalone calendar surface. Three view modes — month (the canonical grid), week (7-column day-rows), agenda (event-grouped list). Distinct from DatePicker (single-value input + popover calendar) — this is the full-screen / detail-card calendar primitive used for scheduling, availability, and resource views. Localized via date-fns / Intl. Honors the system week start.
